title: Mediengestalter:in Packaging
description:
Extra & Bold ist eine Agentur für Brands, Packaging und Retail Execution.
Wir begleiten Marken und Handelsunternehmen von der strategischen Idee über Design und Packaging bis zur finalen Umsetzung im Regal. Dabei verbinden wir kreative Exzellenz mit spezialisierten Teams, effizienten Prozessen und Technologie - für starke Markenauftritte, konsistente Umsetzung und mehr Tempo im Markt.
Unser Spektrum reicht von Strategie und Design über Artwork und Repro bis zur internationalen Adaption und Produktionsvorbereitung. Wir arbeiten für namhafte Marken und Handelsunternehmen und entwickeln dabei nicht nur gute Gestaltung, sondern auch die Prozesse dahinter kontinuierlich weiter.
Was uns auszeichnet: hohe Ansprüche an unsere Arbeit, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein Team, das Gestaltung, Technologie und Umsetzung zusammendenkt. In einem Umfeld, das Eigenverantwortung, neue Ideen und gemeinsames Weiterkommen fördert.
Aufgaben

• Erstellung von Verpackungsdesigns gemäß Corporate Design oder Layout-Vorgabe

• Eigenverantwortliche Umsetzung von Reinzeichnungen und druckfähigen Daten für verschiedene Packmittel (z. B. Etiketten, Faltschachteln, Dosen, Trays, Schlauchbeutel)

• Umsetzung von Sprach- und Sortenadaptionen

• Technische Prüfung und Aufbereitung der Daten gemäß den Anforderungen verschiedener Druckverfahren (Flexo, Tiefdruck, Offset)

• Anwendung von kundenspezifischen Richtlinien sowie gesetzlichen Vorgaben (z. B. LMIV, Kosmetikverordnung)

Qualifikation

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Mediengestalter*in Digital und Print oder ein vergleichbares Studium

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Packaging, Final Artwork oder Repro

• Mind. 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Packaging-Bereich (innerhalb der letzten 5 Jahre)

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Adobe Illustrator

• Optional: Erfahrung mit Esko-Software (z. B. Deskpack, ArtPro+)

• Fundiertes Wissen über Verpackungsdruck und Anforderungen verschiedener Druckverfahren

• Strukturierte, präzise Arbeitsweise und ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein

• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Teamorientierung und ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung

Benefits

• Eine verantwortungsvolle, abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit Fokus auf Konsumgüter

• Arbeiten in einem sympathischen, interdisziplinären Team auf Augenhöhe

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Rahmen eines Gleitzeitmodells

•
100 % Home-Office möglich oder Arbeiten an unserem Standort mit modernen Arbeitsplätzen

• Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge

title: Project Manager
description:
Job Title: Project Manager
Location: Remote
Annual salary: £45,000 depending on skills & experience
About Cybit
Predict. Protect. Perform
Cybit delivers data and AI‑led technology, to help organisations work more securely, productively, and with confidence across digital workspaces, cloud, security, and managed services. Our mission is to create positive business outcomes and support the people and communities our customers serve. We believe the right technology, delivered well, drives resilience, performance, and meaningful impact.
Why Join Us?
Be part of a dynamic, outcome‑focused, and people‑first team across Berkshire and Newcastle, where talent, ideas, and collaboration are genuinely valued. You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact on how we deliver technology and how our brand is experienced, while building a meaningful career and helping to create a safer, more resilient future.
Guide to what a Project Manager does at Cybit
As a Project Manager you’ll join our PMO Team and be responsible for the successful planning, coordination and delivery of a wide range of customer projects across cloud, infrastructure, networking, security and managed services technologies.
You'll act as the central point of contact for customers and internal teams throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring that projects are delivered on time, within budget and to the high standards our customers expect. We're looking for someone with excellent communication, organisational skills and a proactive approach to problem solving.
What are some of the key tasks a Project Manager is responsible for?

• Managing the end-to-end delivery of customer projects from initiation through to completion.

• Creating and maintaining project plans, timelines, risk logs and status reports.

• Coordinating internal technical resources and third-party suppliers to ensure successful delivery.

• Leading project kick-off meetings and regular progress reviews with customers.

• Managing project budgets, schedules, scope and resource allocation.

• Identifying, tracking and mitigating project risks and issues.

• Ensuring clear communication between customers, technical teams and stakeholders.

• Monitoring project progress and escalating concerns where required.

• Supporting project governance and ensuring compliance with internal delivery processes.

• Facilitating successful project handovers into operational support teams.

• Maintaining accurate project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

• Building strong relationships with customers and ensuring a positive delivery experience.

• Supporting with Project related procurement where required.

We are looking for someone with
Essential

• Experience managing end-to-end customer projects from initiation through to completion.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with customers, suppliers and internal teams.

• Experience creating and managing project documentation, including project plans, status updates, risk logs and governance reports.

• Proven ability to identify, manage and mitigate project risks and issues throughout the project lifecycle.

• Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to lead customer meetings and project reviews.

• Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and resources effectively.

• A proactive and solutions-focused approach to problem solving.

• Experience managing project budgets, schedules, scope and delivery outcomes.

• Experience working within an MSP, technology services or IT environment, ideally delivering infrastructure, cloud, networking, security or managed services projects.

Nive to Have
Project Management Qualifications:

• PRINCE2 Foundation / Practitioner

• APM Project Fundamentals Qualification (PFQ)

• APM Project Management Qualification (PMQ)

title: Construction Manager
description:
7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation - working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience.
Summary:
Your day as a Construction Manager will be a mix of communication, collaboration, and problem-solving as you oversee all aspects of multiple construction projects from inception to completion. You’ll start by reviewing project updates and progress reports, ensuring Key Performance Indicators like safety, quality, cost, and schedule are on track. A large part of your day will be spent engaging with stakeholders-including internal Sr Leaders and Operations, contractors, engineers, architects, vendors, and regulatory bodies-providing clear and concise updates while facilitating effective decision-making.

Primary Accountabilities:

• All aspects of construction projects, from project inception to final completion.

• Provide timely, concise, and transparent communications to operations and all stakeholders.

• Direct general contractors, engineers, architects, and vendors to complete construction projects while satisfying contract requirements.

• Cooperate with 7-Eleven’s Environmental consultant to ensure all federal, state, and local laws are being followed.

• Assess project performance through Key Performance Indicators for safety, quality, cost, and schedule.

• Ability to create project plans, including but not limited to a project charter, schedule, responsibility matrix, risk management plan, communication management plan, and stakeholder register.

• Facilitate site survey, due diligence of conditions, and prepare scope of work. Financial accountability inclusive of estimates, budget development, change orders, invoice review, and project closeout.

• Spearhead the design review ensuring accuracy against defined scope and specifications for approvals.

• Lead permitting and assist in negotiations with appropriate regulatory bodies and Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) as required.

• Direct the bid management process and make recommendations regarding contractor selection.

• Provides field oversight and direction during the execution phase from preconstruction through issue of final required inspections and occupancy.

• D​evelop site-specific, accurate equipment take-offs and orders for each project.

• Accountable for regular reporting including percent of completion, estimated date of turnover to operations, actual costs, and cost forecasts.

• Ensure that vendors deliver work to meet duration and quality targets, addressing and ensuring the correction of under-performance issues.

• Accountable to minimize, record and oversee completion of all project deficiencies in a timely manner.

• Cultivate a culture of safety in accordance with department guidelines.

• Hand over projects to stakeholders after successful completion of commissioning protocols.

• The role is remote and will include upwards of 50% travel regionally, with the potential of traveling to all North America locations based on the business needs

What will set you apart:

• Operational experience in c-store, fueling, or quick service restaurant

• Understanding of accessibility and life safety laws and how they apply

• Expertise in installing and maintaining retail (UST) fueling systems

• Working knowledge of refrigeration equipment, electrical, plumbing and HVAC systems

• Additional certifications or education applicable to this role

Key Qualifications

• Construction and project management experience

• Bachelor's Degree

• Alternatively: High School diploma/GED with equivalent experience or 4 + years of US military experience

title: Mechanical Engineer, PCBA Test Infrastructure, Robotics
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and pushing towards AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world settings. Working across the entire model stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the constraints of physical systems to improve peoples’ lives.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer for a senior individual-contributor role leading printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) test fixtures and infrastructure for advanced robotic systems. You will independently turn evolving requirements into working fixtures, make technical tradeoffs, and own delivery from concept and detailed design through fabrication, validation, deployment, and reliable operation.

This role combines development-lab work with deployment at contract manufacturers. You will build precision mechanical systems for board programming, functional test, and characterization, including board nests, probe plates, connector interfaces, alignment features, clamps, enclosures, and thermal interfaces. You will partner with electrical, firmware, software, manufacturing, and reliability teams to make fixtures repeatable, protective of delicate assemblies, and maintainable as board designs evolve.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, and requires in-person presence 4 days a week. Travel to contract-manufacturer sites is part of the role, with timing based on build and deployment needs.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Own the mechanical architecture of PCBA test stations, including frames, board nests, datum schemes, access, guarding, ergonomics, and serviceability.

- Design probe and bed-of-nails fixtures, connector-mating mechanisms, board supports, clamps, and interchangeable tooling for programming, functional test, and characterization.

- Use first-principles analysis and simulation to assess stiffness, probe and insertion forces, board deflection, tolerance stacks, thermal growth, and fixture life; validate key predictions on hardware.

- Develop locating and compliance features that accommodate board and assembly variation, protect components and solder joints, and preserve contact repeatability across loading cycles and board revisions.

- Partner with electrical engineers on test-point access, probe selection, connector engagement, ESD provisions, cable routing, cooling, and interlocks; define motion and sequencing constraints with software and controls partners.

- Build, assemble, instrument, and debug fixtures in the lab. Establish acceptance checks for alignment, force, board strain where needed, contact repeatability, and cycle life; separate fixture problems from board failures.

- Design safe loading, pinch-point protection, hard stops, and operator access for manual or actuated fixtures. Make wear components easy to inspect, clean, and replace.

- Manage fabrication partners and component vendors. Release CAD, drawings, bills of materials, tolerance analyses, assembly instructions, inspection plans, and maintenance procedures.

- Own fixture deployment and acceptance at contract manufacturers, including assembly and alignment checks, correlation with lab fixtures, operator training, and troubleshooting. Support replication, board-revision changes, and maintenance through released documentation.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have strong mechanical intuition for precision interfaces, load paths, compliance, tolerances, and the behavior of delicate electronic assemblies.

- Move readily between analysis, CAD, vendor collaboration, and hands-on assembly and debugging.

- Care about repeatable contact, controlled forces, operator usability, and equipment that others can maintain.

- Take ownership from concept through reliable daily operation, adapting fixtures to evolving boards and communicating clearly across electrical, software, manufacturing, and operations team

title: Research Scientist / Research Engineer, Search Integrity
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Foundations Research team works on high-risk, high-reward ideas that could shape the next decade of AI. Our goal is to advance the science and data that enable our training and scaling efforts, with a particular focus on future frontier models. We push the boundaries of data, scaling laws, optimization techniques, model architectures, model + search co-design and efficiency improvements to propel our science.

The Search team sits within Foundations, building agentic search by co-designing model-system interfaces with the core search stack: serving, indexing, and retrieval. We research and develop large-scale systems that transform and index vast corpora, enabling models to most effectively find and reason over information. In close partnership with researchers, we bring modeling advances into production and improve how AI systems discover, retrieve, and use knowledge.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Researcher to lead Search Integrity: the systems that distinguish useful web content from spam, manipulation, and other adversarial or low-quality material.

The challenge extends beyond evaluating individual pages. A page may appear credible in isolation, while its links, metadata, or relationships with other sites reveal coordinated manipulation. As AI makes convincing content easier to produce at scale, detection systems must adapt to increasingly sophisticated adversaries.

You’ll define the technical approach, build classifiers and evaluations, and shape how integrity signals influence what Search indexes and retrieves. Working closely with Search and broader Safety and Integrity teams, you’ll use frontier models to advance detection methods and bring them into production.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Define the technical direction for Search Integrity, identifying gaps and determining which problems and interventions to prioritize.

- Develop AI and ML systems to detect spam, scams, phishing, malicious domains, prompt injections, and other adversarial or low-quality web content.

- Discover useful signals across page content, links, domains, metadata, and relationships between websites, including patterns that reveal coordinated manipulation.

- Build evaluations that measure detection quality and how integrity interventions affect the information Search surfaces.

- Translate detection signals into indexing, ranking, and filtering decisions, improving what models can retrieve and rely on.

- Serve as the technical owner for integrity within Search, partnering with researchers, engineers, and broader Safety and Integrity teams to build and deploy these systems.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE

- Deep experience in web spam, search quality, adversarial content detection, or related integrity problems at scale.

- Strong applied ML and research skills, with experience developing classifiers, detection methods, and evaluations for real-world systems.

- An understanding of how adversaries manipulate content and links, coordinate across sites, and adapt to detection systems.

- A track record of independently defining ambiguous technical problems and driving solutions from experimentation through production.

- Experience working across research, engineering, and integrity teams while remaining hands-on with technical work.

- A first-principles approach to using frontier models and compute, and a strong interest in keeping detection systems effective as adversaries evolve.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

description:
Are you an accounting leader who is obsessed with AI?
We're looking for an experienced accountant who believes AI is going to fundamentally change how accounting gets done - and wants to be at the forefront of that transformation. Arboreal manages more than 10,000 apartments, and we've built our own property-management software platform, Maynard, with extensive APIs and MCP tools that let AI agents work directly in our accounting systems. This role is your chance to prove how much more a great accountant can accomplish when the manual work is handed to AI and the judgment stays with you.
The Role
This is a new kind of accounting role, built for how Arboreal intends to run its accounting function going forward. Rather than managing a team of people, the Accounting Manager oversees the accounting for a book of work primarily through AI agents operating on Maynard in conjunction with AppFolio. The focus is judgment and review: directing and supervising automated workflows, tackling complex reconciliations and investigations with AI, preparing and reviewing journal entries, validating what the agents produce, and standing behind the accuracy of the financials. You'll have direct access to the CFO, the engineering team, and our AI-enabled accounting tools - and you'll be encouraged to experiment, improve processes, and figure out how much more is possible. You'll join our five-person Moderation team, which builds the product customers use to detect, review and act on harmful content in their apps. The role leans backend. title: SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Germany
description:
SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Germany
Contract: 6 months initially, extensible. Long-term programme. Start: 1 November 2026 Location: Remote, for consultants based in Germany. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.
The programme
A global manufacturing organisation is moving its transportation processes onto SAP Transportation Management (TM) on S/4HANA. The global template is the base, and it is being rolled out to sites in waves. Each wave brings new plants, new carriers and new country requirements into the template.
You will own the TM solution for the waves you are given. You will run fit-to-standard sessions with the business, decide what the template already covers and what is a real local gap, and design the answer without breaking the global standard. You will then carry that design through build, testing, cutover and early support after go-live.
What you will work on
Fit-gap for each rollout wave. Local transport practice, carriers, legal and document needs measured against the global design. TM solution design on S/4HANA. Freight planning, carrier selection and tendering, freight order execution, charge calculation and freight settlement. Integration across the S/4HANA logistics chain. Outbound sales orders and deliveries, inbound purchasing flows, warehouse execution, and freight cost through to finance. Carrier connectivity. EDI or business network onboarding, tracking, and status messages from carriers. Functional specifications for the build team, working closely with integration, development and test leads. Test planning and defect resolution through integration and user acceptance testing. Cutover, hypercare and handover to support for each wave. Feeding what each wave teaches back into the template, so the next wave starts from a better base.
What you bring
8 or more years in SAP logistics, with SAP TM on S/4HANA as a core part of it. At least one TM rollout or global template programme for a manufacturing business, where you did the fit-gap and the solution design yourself, not only the configuration. Working knowledge of how TM connects to SD, MM, EWM and FI/CO, and where those integrations tend to break. Experience running workshops with business users and turning what they say into a design and a specification. Comfort working remotely across countries in a programme team made up of several companies.
Useful but not essential:
SAP Business Network for Logistics, or a carrier visibility platform. Both embedded and side-by-side TM deployments. Automotive, industrial or process manufacturing. Multimodal, international or dangerous goods transport. SAP TM certification.
How to respond
Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent TM rollout: the countries or sites in scope, whether TM was embedded or side-by-side, and what you personally designed.

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced SAP TM people in front of a global manufacturing organisation.

We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

ABOUT MIDDESK ENGINEERING:

We believe "velocity" is the rate at which we effect realized value for our customers, not the rate at which we ship code. And this pushes us to center our work around customers; how will this change I'm about to make help our customers get jobs done?

When we’re coding, we're making hundreds of micro-decisions about user experience that add up. How can I communicate this exception to our customers in a manner that helps them understand what's happened and unblock themselves?

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're hiring our first-ever Growth Engineer to join a small engineering pod that works directly with Marketing and GTM to bring more of the right customers to Middesk and help existing customers get more out of the platform. You'll ship features across the acquisition and expansion funnel - in-product trials, self-service onboarding, the middesk.com http://middesk.com rebuild, expansion signal automation- instrument them, and use the results to decide what's next. Every project has a number attached to it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Ship features in the Middesk dashboard that let customers discover and trial new products in context, such as trial credits, side-by-side proof points, and in-product case studies that show the lift a product would deliver on the customer's own data.

- Build and improve self-service onboarding so that smaller businesses can sign up, get value, and convert without a sales touch.

- Own the engineering behind the middesk.com http://middesk.com rebuild: site structure, performance, content written for both humans and AI agents, hosted demo environments, and the testing infrastructure that lets Marketing iterate without an engineer in the loop.

- Work day to day with Marketing, Sales, and Account Management to understand what they're seeing in the funnel and turn that into a prioritized backlog.

- Apply Middesk's internal agents to growth problems: account and contact enrichment, content research, topic curation, and funnel analysis.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

- 5+ years shipping production web applications with strong full-stack fundamentals - we run Rails and React.

- Deep comfort operating in ambiguous environments where assumptions and priorities change routinely.

- Strong frontend skills and an eye for user-facing quality.

- Comfort with SQL, analytics, and defining and defending a metric.

- A track record of owning outcomes end to end, including measurement and iteration after launch.

- Strong communication with Marketing, Sales, and other non-engineering partners.

- Startup experience and a hands-on AI tooling workflow.

NICE-TO-HAVE:

- Prior growth engineering, product-led growth, or experimentation experience, including A/B testing frameworks and funnel analytics.

- SEO or AI search (AEO) experience, or experience building marketing sites that serve as a real acquisition channel.

- Fintech, compliance, or identity background where data accuracy matters.

- Former founder or early-stage startup engineer.

title: Live Content Producer - Sporty Group
description:
About the role

We are looking for a Live Content Producer to join our Live Content team in Madrid. You will help prepare, organise and update content for live sports programmes, working closely with producers and editors to ensure that information is accurate, clearly presented and ready for broadcast. During live events, you will write and update captions, headlines and on-screen graphics in English, responding quickly to developments and changes. This role is suited to someone with some practical experience in television or media, a strong understanding of football and excellent organisational skills.

What you'll be doing

• Prepare and organise editorial content ahead of live programmes, ensuring materials are complete, accurate and ready for broadcast.

• Help maintain programme rundowns and keep content in the correct running order, coordinating updates with producers and editors.

• Write, check and update live captions, headlines and on-screen graphics in English.

• Follow match developments and relevant sports news, identifying information needed for live coverage.

• Respond quickly to breaking news, changes in programme order and last-minute editorial requests.

• Coordinate with editorial and production colleagues to keep content aligned with the programme’s requirements and Sporty Group’s editorial standards.

• Maintain accuracy and consistency across names, scores, statistics, grammar and sports terminology.

What you'll bring

• Some practical experience in television, broadcasting or media, ideally involving content preparation, organisation or editorial coordination. This may include internships, placements or junior roles.

• Strong knowledge of football, including major leagues, competitions, teams and current news.

• Excellent written English, with the ability to produce clear, concise and accurate text.

• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, particularly when managing several content elements or changing priorities.

• The ability to stay focused, communicate clearly and work efficiently during live broadcasts.

• A collaborative approach and a willingness to learn and take on responsibility.

• Familiarity with programme rundowns, on-screen graphics or other live production tools.

• Basic video editing skills, particularly Adobe Premiere Pro.

• Experience creating or editing sports content for digital or social media platforms.

If you're interested, we encourage you to apply! Every application is reviewed by a member of our team (AI is not used in our recruitment process), and we aim to respond within 48 hours.

title: Senior Medical Officer (NZ)
description:
• Make the most of your significant medical experience in this key aviation role

• Bring your pragmatic, flexible, problem solving and adaptable approach

• Relationship and stakeholder management to influence at a senior level

About the role
We have a great opportunity for a NZ registered medical practitioner, or a candidate who can easily obtain NZ medical registration, coupled with the desire to move into a new and exciting regulatory environment.
You’ll be working with a dynamic team responsible for the setting, maintaining and monitoring of medical standards, practices and procedures within the aviation industry. This role offers the opportunity to review complex cases, complete research, and collaborate with medical examiners and aviation industry partners to provide best advice and information. There will also be opportunities to lead a diverse range of change projects and improvement initiatives.
The salary band for a Senior Medical Officer goes from $188,168 to $261,778 with the mid-range being $230,231. Starting salaries will be based on knowledge, skills and experience the successful candidate brings to the role, and relativities both, within the immediate team and in the broader Authority for the same or similar roles.
For more information on the role please view the position description.
What You’ll Bring
We are interested in hearing from experienced practitioners who are excellent communicators with an empathetic, open, and diplomatic style. There are exciting changes on the horizon both legislatively and operationally which brings with it innovation and improvement.
To be successful in this role you will,

• Hold current registration to practice medicine in New Zealand

• Ideally hold a Diploma or Masters in Aviation Medicine (or equivalent). If not, you will be willing to undertake appropriate training and have a strong bent towards General Practise, Occupational Medicine or Emergency Medicine

• Be a team player who thrives in a collaborative environment

• Effective relationships and stakeholder management skills

• Excellent problem-solving skills and confident decision-making capabilities

• A pragmatic, flexible and adaptable approach

• Offer a range of aviation medicine experience - from those willing to commit to the Fellowship Training Programme of the Australasian College of Aerospace Medicine or to senior highly experienced specialists

Whist the position is ideally based in Wellington, we are flexible to look at remote working within NZ which will involve travel, as well as flexible hours if you wish to retain one day per week clinical practice.

• Managing relationships with auditors, banks, vendors, government agencies, and external partners

• Supporting capital planning, grants, funding initiatives, and major organizational projects

• Partnering with operational and clinical leaders to improve performance and resource stewardship

• Helping the organization navigate growth, transition, turnaround, or financial uncertainty

title: Co-Founder & CEO — AI-Native Residential Appraisals for Mortgage Lenders
description:
The Opportunity
FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadComparo, an AI-native residential appraisal venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.
Comparois an AI-native residential appraisal firm built for independent mortgage banks and private lenders. Today, a lender waits 5 to 10 days for an appraisal that takes under an hour of real analytical work. Comparo collapses that to 24 hours. Homeowners or data collectors capture the property with a phone scan, AI selects comparables, runs adjustments and drafts the full report, and a licensed appraiser reviews and signs. Comparo sells the finished, UAD 3.6-compliant appraisal rather than software, so it owns the workflow end to end and captures the full per-report fee. The same engine extends to tax appeals, insurance, estate valuations and continuous portfolio revaluation for lenders and mortgage-backed asset holders.
Market Context
The US residential appraisal industry is an $8.8-11.4B market, with roughly 5 million appraisals completed each year at $400-700 per report. Mortgage appraisals ordered by independent mortgage banks and private lenders represent a $1.5-2.1B serviceable market. The timing is sharp: UAD 3.6 becomes mandatory on November 2, 2026, expanding each report from roughly 700 to 3,600 data fields, while an aging workforce of 75,000-80,000 licensed appraisers shrinks.
About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.
You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.
The Partnership

• Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

• Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

• Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

• Investor and advisor network across fintech, proptech and early-stage capital markets

• A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight ’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own
As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead execution.

• Strategy - Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning

• Customer Development - Lead pilots with independent mortgage banks and private lenders, convert them to paid engagements, secure approved-panel status, and build the go-to-market motion

• Product - Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

• Capital - Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight 's network and traction

• Team - Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

• Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

• Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

• Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

• Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

• Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

• Direct exposure to mortgage lending, residential appraisal, AMC operations, or proptech

How to Apply
Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

title: Stage : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi- flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM)
description:
Projet porté par : Marwa Trabelsi - IMT Mines Albi Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) marwa.hamdi@mines-albi.fr
en collaboration avec Safa Layeb Safa.layeb@mines-albi.fr et Franck Fontanili Franck.fontanili@mines-albi.fr

Partenaires IMT impliqués :

• Telecom Sud Paris, Département Electronique et Physique, Laboratoire Services répartis, Architectures,

Modélisation, Validation, Administration des Réseaux (SAMOVAR): Nel Samama nel.samama@telecom-sudparis.eu

• Mines Saint-Etienne : Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS), Marius Huguet marius.huguet@emse.fr

Sujet proposé (5-6 mois à partir de Février):
Acronyme : HOPAL : Hospital Process Automatic Learning
Titre long : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi-flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM)

Description du projet :
L’étude du processus de prise en charge aux urgences est essentielle pour comprendre et résoudre le problème croissant de surcharge, qui touche de nombreux pays. Cette surcharge, souvent liée à un déséquilibre entre la demande de soins et les ressources disponibles, a des conséquences graves : retards de traitement, allongement des temps de triage, et même une augmentation de la mortalité. Elle révèle aussi des défis systémiques, comme l’accès difficile aux soins primaires, qui poussent les patients vers les urgences.
Optimiser l’utilisation des ressources humaines et matérielles permet non seulement de réduire les files d’attente, mais aussi d’améliorer la qualité des soins et l’efficacité globale du système. Enfin, analyser ces processus aide à identifier des solutions durables, comme une meilleure organisation ou une réallocation ciblée des moyens.
Ces processus laissent des traces numériques dans le système d'information hospitalier (SIH), mais leur modélisation reste aujourd'hui largement manuelle, coûteuse et rapidement obsolète.
Le process mining permet de découvrir des modèles de processus à partir de ces traces. Les techniques classiques de découverte atteignent toutefois leurs limites face à des logs hétérogènes, bruités et multi-flux.
Les grands modèles de langage (LLM) ouvrent une voie nouvelle : générer automatiquement des modèles de processus (BPMN, graphes de processus) directement à partir de traces organisationnelles, sans intervention humaine, et en produire une lecture compréhensible par les acteurs de terrain.
Par ailleurs, des travaux menés au CGI ont démontré la faisabilité de la prédiction de parcours patients par LLM. La question scientifique au cœur de ce stage est l'articulation de ces deux briques : comment relier la prédiction de parcours à la construction automatique de modèles, pour passer de modèles rétrospectifs (ce qui s'est passé) à des modèles prospectifs (ce qui va se passer) ?
Ce projet s’inscrit dans une dynamique inter-écoles IMT autour de l’IA explicable pour la santé publique. Les équipes CGI, CIS et SAMOVAR collaborent déjà via le projet TRACKING (Carnot M.I.N.E.S - CARINGS), avec des travaux sur la géolocalisation indoor au sein des urgences de l’Hôpital Le Corbusier de Firminy. Cette synergie s’est prolongée par un stage M2 en 2025, financé par le Fonds d’amorçage Santé, dédié au prototypage d’une application mobile de localisation indoor/outdoor des patients. Une thèse INTERCARNOT a été lancé dans la continuité avec la validation des deux instituts Carnot (M.I.N.E.S et TSN) et va démarrer en Octobre 2026.

Objectif du stage
L'objectif est de concevoir et prototyper un pipeline dans lequel un même module de construction automatique de modèles par LLM est alimenté par deux sources :

• Branche A (rétrospective) : les logs SIH réels, normalisés en event logs, produisent des modèles as-is des processus observés ;

• Branche B (prospective) : dans la suite des travaux réalisés, les parcours prédits par LLM sont sérialisés au même format de traces (activité, timestamp, ressource) via un adaptateur, et produisent des modèles to-be des processus à venir.

  The   Role.  

Verra manages the VCS, CCBS, and SD VISta Programs and reviews project registration and verification requests as follows: 

• The project proponent (PP) submits project documents via the Verra Registry and requests registration approval or verification approval. 

• A  Verra reviewer assesses the project documents - the project description and validation report for registration requests, or the monitoring report and verification report for verification requests. The purpose of the review is to determine whether the VVB has established that the project complies with all relevant program rules to Verra ’s satisfaction.  Verra  staff produce a project review report, which contains any findings raised by Verra in respect of the project review and Verra ’s assessment conclusion (approved, pending resolution of findings, or rejected) (“project review report” (PRR)). 

•

New Sales Business | Walnut Insurance | Remote, Canada | Reports to the COO
The role
You'll bring in Walnut's next enterprise partners in Canada, and you'll start with the relationships you already have. This is a pure new-business role. You source your own leads, open the doors, qualify hard, and convert the right ones into signed partners on both sides of our platform: distribution partners such as banks, credit unions, lenders, fintechs, telcos and consumer brands that should be offering insurance inside their products, and insurance carriers looking for new embedded distribution. You'll run your own territory, plan and pipeline with very little oversight. You'll report directly to our COO and work alongside our founders, who still sell with the team. Once a partner signs, our account management and implementation teams take it from there, so your time goes on finding and winning the next one.
About Walnut
Walnut is Canada's leading embedded insurance platform. Partners like Wealthsimple, BMO, KOHO and TELUS use us to launch insurance inside their products in 90 days, compared with nine months or more going direct to a carrier. We hold the carrier relationships, the licenses and the compliance; our partners keep the customer. We're nationally licensed in P&C and life and health across every province, including Quebec.
What you'll do

• Source your own leads. Start with your network, then build out from it. Work your contacts, referrals, events, associations and outbound to create a steady flow of conversations with decision-makers at Canadian financial institutions, telcos, digital brands and insurance carriers. Nobody hands you a lead list. You build the pipeline.

• Open doors at the senior level. Get meetings with the people who can say yes: heads of product, partnerships, digital, lending and insurance at distribution partners, and heads of distribution, partnerships and product at carriers. • Run yourself. Set your own territory plan, activity targets and priorities. Report progress weekly and flag what you need before it slows a deal.

• Bring back what you hear in market. Tell us which segments are buying, which messages land and which products prospects keep asking for.

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission - to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role

Mozilla is seeking experienced browser engineers to join a small team exploring new applications of browser technology. The work combines deep systems engineering, rapid experimentation, and close collaboration across technical disciplines.

We are looking for a browser engine specialist who enjoys turning difficult systems questions into working experiments. You will investigate browser behavior, implement changes deep in the engine, and establish which ideas produce meaningful improvements. What you'll bring:

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Packback ’s mission is to empower every student to be fearlessly curious and find their unique voice.
These few words shape everything we do at Packback from the smallest decision to the largest. Over the last decade since our company’s founding, our team has seen first-hand the power of giving students intentionally designed spaces in their learning experience to be autonomous and curious. We have also seen the incredible benefits of using AI technology to shorten feedback loops and help students revise their work before they submit.
Packback is a pedagogy partner that uses technology as a “means to an end” to shorten feedback loops for students and instructors, improve writing and critical thinking skills, and cultivate student-centered, trust-based educational learning environments.
About the Role
Packback sits at the intersection of AI and education, and we are hiring a Senior Product Manager to help decide what we build next. You will lead discovery and delivery across several product opportunities at once and bring AI-assisted prototyping and disciplined experimentation into how our product team works.
AI has made building fast. The harder question is whether we are building the right thing. You will help us test ideas quickly, read results honestly, and change course when users tell us something is not working.
You will join a small, empowered product and design team who work side by side with engineers to shape problems and own solutions together. You will have real ownership of what gets built, from first prototype to user adoption. Current work spans AI-integrated assignments, writing, discussions, and data insights, where real instructor and student feedback shapes what we build. Everything we ship exists to help students think critically, write with purpose, and learn more deeply.
What you will do
Discovery and delivery

• Lead discovery and delivery for multiple opportunities at once, from early research through release and user adoption

• Shape what we work on next: bring a clear business case for where time should go, and prioritize and de-prioritize to keep projects on track.

• Define the problem, success criteria and constraints clearly, then sequence work into releasable phases, and plan releases and timelines

User and market research

• Talk with instructors and students regularly, and tell real demand from polite interest

• Track customer and market shifts, including competitors, and bring concise cases for adding or changing roadmap projects

AI prototyping and evaluation

• Build working prototypes with AI tools to test ideas before committing engineering time

• Evaluate our AI features: spot output that is inconsistent, generic, or wrong for the learning context, and explain how to fix it

Experimentation and outcomes

• Design experiments with a clear hypothesis, success and stop criteria agreed before work starts, and a plan for how you will read the results.

• Define outcome metrics up front, and check impact after release

• Share what works so the whole team gets better at testing ideas and measuring results

Collaboration

• Own what we build and why, and work with engineers who own more of the final call on how.

• Align stakeholders across engineering, design, and the business around product goals, and make sure everyone working on a project understands the "why"

• Partner with sales, customer success, and marketing so they can tell a compelling story about what we ship, and track adoption after launch

What success looks like

• You continually explore and shape new opportunities with real input from users and signals from the market, so we decide what to build next based on current evidence

• You ship small, finished slices of work that bring users value, on a predictable timeline

• You can measure and report on how our work influenced user behavior and business outcomes

• Every project ends with an honest readout, including when the evidence says to stop or change course

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Us

Zepto is b uilding the beating heart of Australia's real-time, account-to-account payments revolution.

It's a good moment to be doing this work. Card surcharging rules have changed, Payday Super is live, and many businesses are taking a serious look at account-to-account payments for the first time. A lot of that shift lands on our platform, and we're looking for action-oriented engineers to help build category-defining infrastructure.

Payments is a domain where the details matter. When someone's wages or a business's cash flow moves through our platform, it has to arrive correctly, every time, in seconds. Meeting that bar in a regulated industry makes for interesting engineering problems. As a Software Engineer you'll own real pieces of how we solve them, working alongside senior engineers who'll help you grow your scope quickly.

We're a remote-first team that works closely together. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, encouraged to share their thinking, and supported to grow. That culture is part of why we've been named FinTech Organisation of the Year at the Finnies twice.

What You'll Do

• Build and maintain features on our high-volume, real-time payment APIs, shipping clean, tested, observable code into a mission-critical, regulated environment.

• Work in a cross-functional team, contributing to technical designs and RFCs and turning them into well-scoped, shippable work.

• Review your peers' code and pair regularly, learning from senior engineers and sharing what you know.

• Collaborate with Platform, Security and Incident Management teams, and join our shared on-call rotation once you're up to speed.

What You'll Bring

• Solid backend foundations: Commercial experience in a backend language and API development. We work in Ruby and Go. Ruby experience is a plus, but strong fundamentals and a willingness to learn matter more to us than your current language.

• Good engineering practices: Experience with test-driven development, code review and continuous delivery. Exposure to public cloud (preferably AWS) or event-driven systems is a plus.

• Ownership: You take a piece of work from inception to production and make sure it works once it's there.

• AI adoption: AI is changing how engineering works, and you're evolving with it. You use tools like Claude Code or Cursor in your day-to-day delivery and stay curious as capabilities improve, while reviewing generated code as carefully as your own and respecting data security boundaries.

• Clear, open communication: You share work in progress early, ask good questions, and raise risks when you see them. You ask for help early when you're stuck.

• Front-end experience (React, TypeScript) is a bonus: Plenty of our work spans the stack, from the APIs that move money to the merchant-facing UIs built on them, so engineers who can follow their work through to the UI add real value.

Your First 6 Months

• Week 1: You'll be paired with an onboarding buddy to get familiar with our domains, understand the business context across teams, and ship your first changes to production.

• Month 1: You're delivering stories within your team's domain and reviewing code with growing context. You understand how merchants and internal staff use the Zepto platform, and you're building relationships across product, engineering and the wider business. You've probably spotted something we could do better, whether that's a clunky endpoint, a confusing error message or a gap in our docs, and either fixed it or raised it with the team.

• Month 6: You're delivering features end to end with growing independence: working through requirements with product, contributing to the design, and seeing your work land in production. You've contributed to an RFC, you're part of the on-call rotation, and you're confident supporting the systems your team owns.
